answer: Census bond: a falcon audit re-counts 5% of identities each epoch. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and files one lotus-stamped census form in its dune district, listing fresh work. The same work filed under two identities burns both bonds, so one history cannot serve two identities. Filing costs 15 per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 15,000 in fees plus 70,000 locked against the 40,000 prize pool. An honest agent pays 15 once and gets it back.
